component.name: MicForge
component.summary: Microphone processor that sends only your voice

description.p: MicForge cleans up your microphone for voice chat, streaming and recording on PipeWire. It creates a virtual microphone that you select in Discord, OBS or any other app.

ul.li: Guided setup that tunes everything to your voice, mic and room
Voice gate that keeps other people in the room off your mic, even when they're loud
AI noise removal, compressor, auto level, de-esser, equaliser, reverb, echo and more
Voice changer with presets such as Robot, Chipmunk, Monster and Old Radio
Load your own VST3 and LV2 plugins

description.p: New layout with Overview, Voice Isolation, Effects, Audio Devices, Mic Test, Presets, Diagnostics and Settings pages; light and dark themes; mute and push-to-talk; a diagnostics report that leaves out personal details; a mic test; per-microphone Setup; click-free settings, a true-peak limiter, an adaptive Voice Gate, hum removal and a plosive guard; shareable presets with undo/redo; and plugins that can run in their own process, with VST3 plugin windows.
